checks.name: products-one-by-one-layout
checks.evidence: On /products, each of the four product cards (product-card-saw-dust/wood-powder/wood-shavings/wooden-flakes) is a full-width row (>800px wide at 1280 viewport) stacked vertically in order with no y-overlap. Image/text sides alternate: saw-dust image left of its text (index 0, not reversed) while wood-powder image is right of its text (index 1, reversed). All four cards remain visible and non-collided at 390x844 mobile viewport.

checks.evidence: After scrolling homepage to home-cta-section (scrollY > 100px) and clicking nav-link-about-us, the /about-us destination renders about-hero with window.scrollY <= 5, confirming an instant top reset via the existing pathname-based window.scrollTo(0,0) effect in SiteLayout.

checks.evidence: On /about-us, about-value-0..3 all share the same x coordinate (single column, Set size = 1) and are stacked with strictly increasing, non-overlapping y positions, confirming a single vertical numbered list rather than a multi-column grid.
